This record formulates the stronger quantitative question answered negatively by the linked paper: no finite constant works, even over this one fixed connected function algebra and at degree three. It is not attributed as the literal question of Krishna's Conjecture 2.1. That source proposed constant one over commutative C*-algebras, and public scalar counterexamples already refute it; no first-refutation claim is made here. The new statement is the failure of every finite constant under the explicit stronger hypotheses above. Classical scalar Smale bounds are not contradicted.
